Global Pet Industries Ltd. Buyback (Global Pet Industries Buyback September 2026) Detail

Tender Offer | ₹13.56 Crores | Listing at NSE | -

Buyback Detail
Messages
News
FAQs

Global Pet Industries Ltd. Buyback is a tender offer for the repurchase of up to 8.48 lakh equity shares, representing 24.55% of the total paid-up equity share capital at a buyback price of ₹160 per share with a face value of ₹10 per share, aggregating to ₹13.56 crores.

The record date for determining eligible shareholders is Sep 25, 2026. Shareholders holding equity shares as on the record date are eligible to participate in the buyback.

Mark Corporate Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the Manager to the Buyback, Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the Registrar to the Buyback.

About Global Pet Industries Ltd.

Incorporated in July 2013, Global Pet Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and export of Two-Stage PET Stretch Blow Moulding Machines used for producing PET bottles, jars and other packaging containers. The Company has over 25 years of technical experience in PET blow moulding technology and operates from Vasai, Maharashtra.

The Company offers a range of PET blow moulding machines, including Semi-Automatic PET Blowing Machines, Fully Automatic PET Stretch Blow Moulding Machines, 3 and 4 Cavity Eco Series machines, and 2, 4 and 6 Cavity All-Electric Servo Series machines. Its machines are designed for applications across food and beverages, edible oils, pharmaceuticals, personal care, food-grade packaging and industrial products.

Its fully automatic machines incorporate features such as automatic preform feeding, servo-driven systems, PLC-based controls, hydraulic or pneumatic mould clamping, infrared heating and integrated cooling systems. The Company's machines can support bottle and container sizes ranging from small bottles to large jars, with certain models offering production capacities of up to 7,000 bottles per hour.

The Company has developed its business across domestic and international markets and states that it has executed projects across 30+ countries. Its customer base includes established companies in the beverage and FMCG sectors, while its product portfolio also serves pharmaceutical and food-grade packaging applications.

Necessity of the Issue

The Company proposes to utilise the Net Proceeds from the Issue towards the following objects:

  • Return surplus funds to shareholders and enhance overall shareholder returns.
  • Optimise the Company’s capital structure.
  • Improve financial ratios such as earnings per share and return on equity.
  • Enhance long-term shareholder value.
  • Provide shareholders the flexibility to either participate in the Buyback for cash or retain their shareholding and benefit from an increased post-buyback ownership.

    Letter of Offer

    All the eligible Shareholders of the Company holding either Physical Shares or Demat Shares as on the Record Date can participate in the buyback offer through their Stock Broker.

    The eligible shareholder holding the shares in Demat form needs to inform their broker the details of the Equity shares they wish to tender in the Buyback Offer. The shareholder needs to transfer the tendered shares to a Special account of the clearing corporation. The broker, in turn, would place an order on the stock exchange for the buyback.

    The eligible shareholder holding the shares in physical form needs to approach their broker with original share certificates and supporting documents. Upon completion of document verification, the broker places an order on the stock exchange and submits the original share certificate and TRS to the registrar.

    The tender form and TRS are optional in the case of Demat shares but mandatory in the case of physical shares.

    The Global Pet Industries Buyback September 2026 offers an opportunity for the shareholders to exit their positions at a premium price. In case you stay invested you would have an increased percentage of shareholding in the company and improved earnings per share. Thus, one should understand the company fundamentals along with one's need, goals, and risk appetite to decide if one wants to stay invested or participate in the buyback offer.
